docs.text:
Form 4 - statement of changes in beneficial ownership

Reporting person: OYELARAN-STROUD MARGUERITE. CIK of reporting person: 0009000812.
Address of reporting person: 41 Sedgeby Lane, Louisville, Kentucky.

Issuer: Kilnbrook Distilling Company. CIK of issuer: 0009000813.
Relationship of reporting person to issuer: Officer. Title: Chief Financial Officer.

Transaction: disposition of 900 shares to cover withholding on a vested award.

The filing names the reporting person as an officer of the issuer and records no other employer.

I did not write down who it was.

expect.note: The confirmed half of the frozen corpus's refused EDGAR case. The filing names the reporting person surname-first (OYELARAN-STROUD MARGUERITE), so the name match has to be order-free, and the issuer IS the person's own employer -- Kilnbrook Distilling -- with an officer relationship, which is the name AND company match DESIGN Decision 4 requires for an SEC CIK. The reporting person's CIK (0009000812), not the issuer's (0009000813), is the key. Both are ten-digit identifiers beginning 0009, far above the allocated range, so neither can name a real filer. One `yes` verdict carries the case because the key does not need a second attribute.
